title: Level up
prompt: The robot's `level` is a member starting at 1. Write `level_up`, which adds 1 to level. In `level_after_two`, call it twice. Then return level, which is 3.
hints: The helper needs no parameter; it always adds one.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var level = 1

func level_after_two():
	level_up()
	level_up()
	return level

func level_up():
	level += 1
